meta.name: business-model-design
meta.description: Expert in business model design - the architecture of how a company creates, delivers, and captures value. Covers business model canvas, revenue model selection, value chain design, and business model innovation. Knows when to copy proven models and when to innovate. Use when "business model, revenue model, how to monetize, unit economics, value proposition, business model canvas, business model innovation, " mentioned.
